get.description: Return open items statistics for a project (all users)

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: Limits the statistics to a single item type. When omitted or unrecognized, all of the listed types are counted together.

count.description: Total number of open items counted.

open_count.description: Number of items due more than seven days from now, plus items with no due date.

upcoming_count.description: Number of items due between today and seven days from now.

overdue_count.description: Number of items whose due date has already passed.

last_activity.description: Timestamp of the most recent update across the counted items. Null when no items matched.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/open_items/all?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&tool_name=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
